QuestInfo.name: [Title] Ultimate Champion
QuestInfo.0: There seems to be special title that can only be obtained in Battle Mode. Go to Maximus the knight and find out what that is.
QuestInfo.1: If you defeat a whole lot of enemies in Battle Mode, you can obtain the #bUltimate Champion#k title. The Ultimate Champion, one who has defeated 1,000 foes! Take up on the challenge to become the Ultimate Champion!
QuestInfo.2: You received a title from Maximus.

0.0: You here for Battle Mode? Thinking about trying out for some of those #btitles#k?
0.1: There are all kinds of titles you can get in Battle Mode. You ever see anybody with an #bUltimate Champion#k title? I bet you haven't. Anybody THAT tough spends most of their time hanging out in the training rooms.
0.2: If you think you can beat down 1000 enemies, I'll give you the best title of all... the #bUltimate Champion#k. How about it?

yes.0: You're gonna do just fine in Battle Mode. Take on the challenge and show us what you can do.

no.0: Not into glory and fame and being recognized as the best, huh? Can't say I'm surprised...

1.0: You really are a beast of battle! You are the Ultimate Champion!
